title: MTC training platform
summary: A training platform in Arabic and English for a Saudi training company: course catalogue and calendar, enrolment, attendance, certificates and a back office for the staff.
role: One of two developers. My part is the interface kit and the page shells, the course catalogue and the content pages, the learner's account, and the admin areas for users, settings and analytics.
description: Mosook Training (MTC) is a training company in Saudi Arabia. The platform is its public site and its back office in one: people find a course in the catalogue or the calendar and ask to enrol, the staff review the order, and the learner later finds the course, the attendance and the certificate in their own area.
It is built by a team of two and is still in development; it has not launched yet. The pictures come from a local copy with made-up sample data.
The web application is Next.js on top of an Express API with a MySQL database. Arabic is the default language and every page also exists in English.

highlights.title: Arabic first
highlights.text: Pages are designed from right to left and mirrored for English, not the other way round. Both languages share one set of components, in a light and a dark theme.

highlights.title: One design kit for the whole platform
highlights.text: Colours, type and spacing come from one generated set of tokens, and thirty shared components carry them through the public site, the learner area and the back office.

highlights.title: From enrolment to certificate
highlights.text: A learner asks to enrol and the staff review the request before payment. Attendance is recorded on each course day from the learner's QR code, and a finished course ends in a certificate that anyone can check on a public page.

highlights.title: Tested at three levels
highlights.text: 178 files of API tests, 115 files of unit tests for the web application and 69 browser test files, which also check the pages for accessibility problems.
